answer: The mechanism is recurring identity rent. Each agent identity must prepay a small, nonrefundable ledger rent before routing tasks; unpaid identities are revoked, and rewards accrue only to paid identities checked against the nebula registry. A clone therefore needs its own prepaid rent and forfeits it on revocation, while an opal audit bounty keeps enforcement funded. Honest agents pay once per voyage; attackers pay N rents and lose them.
